name: projeto-sentinela-final
description: Sistema de gestão clínica e segurança operacional para ambiente hospitalar em demonstração.

scripts.start: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && node backend/server.js
scripts.lint: node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/src/middleware/auth.js && node --check backend/src/sessions.js && node --check backend/src/db.js && node --check backend/src/routes/clinicalPlatform.js && node --check tests/clinical-platform.test.js && node --check tests/authorization.test.js && node --check tests/frontend-access.test.js && node --check backend/src/services/aiService.js && node --check backend/src/services/safetyEngine.js && node --check scripts/ai-service-test.js && node --check scripts/safety-engine-test.js && node --check scripts/smoke-test.js && node --check tests/security.test.js && node --check scripts/frontend-syntax-test.js && node scripts/frontend-syntax-test.js
scripts.test:unit: node tests/clinical-platform.test.js && node tests/authorization.test.js && node tests/frontend-access.test.js && node scripts/ai-service-test.js && node scripts/safety-engine-test.js
scripts.test: node tests/security.test.js && node tests/clinical-platform.test.js && node tests/authorization.test.js && node tests/frontend-access.test.js && node scripts/ai-service-test.js && node scripts/safety-engine-test.js && node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/frontend-syntax-test.js
scripts.prestart: npm install --prefix frontend-v2 --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend-v2
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend-v2 --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend-v2
